messages:
liz: Quick sync 1: incoming pen-test (ACME) intake + retest planning. Need to confirm RBAC windows, KMS scoping, and evidence delivery format.

dan: I can run the evidence export. preference: readroom for live verification, but presigned URLs as a fallback.

saurav: Readroom preferred for controlled exploit attempts. presigned urls ok for static artifacts.

irene: Heads up: we'll rotate staging key alias next week. if anyone relies on key id rather than alias, exports might break.

infra-bot: Scheduled key rotation: alias/staging-pt -> 2025-09-02T04:30Z.

dan: Which alias exactly? need to snapshot any encrypted artifacts before rotation.

irene: alias: alias/redwood-staging-pt. export cutoff set 2025-09-02T03:45Z.

saurav: On RBAC: we should provision ephemeral assessors via STS with an IAM session limited to S3:GetObject + kms:Decrypt for the evidence key only. No other kms:* perms.

liz: Agreed. make sure policy uses condition keyed to the evidence bucket prefix and the assessor session tag (e.g., "x-pt-ticket").

dan: Example policy snippet I'll use:

```
- Action: kms:Decrypt
  Resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:alias/redwood-pt-evidence
```

saurav: Also enable CloudTrail data-events for S3 object-level and KMS API calls during the assessor window so we have request-level audit.

infra-bot: CloudTrail update queued: add data-event mapping for S3 bucket `pt-evidence-*` and KMS `alias/redwood-pt-evidence`.

liz: For verification checklist propose: 1) patch merged + CI green; 2) staging deploy; 3) smoke tests; 4) assessor verifies in readroom; 5) upload signed manifest + artifacts.

irene: Signed manifest format: newline-delimited JSON with fields: `path,sha256,uploaded_by,ts,jira`. must be detached-signed by uploader.

dan: I'll produce sample manifest and a small uploader script that computes SHA256 and signs the manifest with our internal key.

saurav: Also tag JIRA ticket with `pt:verify-<date>` and include manifest S3 path in the ticket.

liz: Timeline: dry-run Tuesday 2025-09-03 16:00 UTC, live retest Thursday 2025-09-05 09:00 UTC. Owners: dan (evidence), sa urav (assessment coord), irene (kms/iam).

dan: I'll prep presigned-url fallback and the readroom invite.

irene: I'll open infra PR to scope kms decrypt and create ephemeral role. PR link when ready.

infra-bot: PR created: https://git.internal/infra/pull/812 (ephemeral-role + KMS scoping).

sec-bot: Runbook updated: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/pen-test-retest (rev b12).

saurav: Small ask: can we rotate ephemeral session tokens every 20 minutes during the assessor window? reduces blast radius.

irene: yes, will add session duration and rotation note into the IAM template.

liz: Evidence retention reminder: exports go to `s3://pt-evidence/1834567890/` and retained per policy 365 days for PT artifacts.

dan: Uploads will include `manifest.jsonl` and `signed-manifest.asc`. sample path: `s3://pt-evidence/1834567890/manifest-20250902.jsonl`.

saurav: After retest, we'll need an audit bundle: manifest, cloudtrail exports, and a short verification report attached to the JIRA.

sec-bot: Action items created: PT-901 (evidence upload script), PT-902 (kms policy PR), PT-903 (cloudtrail data-events), PT-904 (retest schedule).

irene: I'll request review from @maggie and @owen once PR is up.

liz: OK. reconvene for preflight 2025-09-02 10:30 UTC. Thanks everyone.

dan: will post sample manifest + uploader before EOD. :rocket:

saurav: Linking the tracker board: https://jira.internal/secure/RapidBoard.jspa?rapidView=42&projectKey=PT

infra-bot: Audit export completed: s3://pt-evidence/1834567890/cloudtrail-export-20250902.tar.gz

liz: Good work. closing thread, follow-ups in PT-902/PT-903.
